UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure data-testid attributes are included on all interactive elements (buttons, menu triggers, project cards, mobile joystick, back buttons).
DO NOT add transparent background without backdrop blur on headers or menu overlays.
Ensure smooth camera lerp (using R3F useFrame) following character's world position.
Mobile touch controls must render virtual joystick and interaction button seamlessly without blocking key 3D elements.
Proximity detection must calculate distance between character position vector and destination positions in useFrame loop.
